defs.meaning: 轰炸（bombard 的过去分词）；炮击；向……连续提问题

examples.en: We have been bombarded with letters of complaint.
examples.zh: 我们接二连三收到了大批的投诉信件。

examples.en: He bombarded Catherine with questions to which he should have known the answers.
examples.zh: 他不停地追问凯瑟琳他本该知道答案的问题。

examples.en: They were bombarded by more than 100 representatives firing questions on pollution.
examples.zh: 他们遭到了一百多位代表就污染问题连珠炮似的发问。
